replacements.source: Depois de ler algo de fora, pedir antes do que não dá pra desfazer
replacements.before: After reading something from outside, ask before what can’t be undone
replacements.after: Require approval for irreversible actions after reading external content
replacements.reason: Matches the shared requirement label exactly; requires rendered measurement.

replacements.before: With the guard below on, what can’t be undone after reading something from outside asks too.

replacements.source: Cada agente tem as suas, na página dele, em Ferramentas. Lá dá pra ver e tirar.
replacements.before: Each agent has its own, on its page, under Tools. That’s where you see and remove them.
replacements.after: Review and remove each agent’s rules on its page under Tools.
replacements.reason: Direct instruction preserves the rules’ canonical location.

replacements.source: Nenhuma ainda. “Aprovar e sempre permitir”, num pedido, cria uma.
replacements.before: None yet. “Approve and always allow”, on a request, makes one.
replacements.after: No rules yet. “Approve and always allow” on a request creates one.
replacements.reason: Retains the exact action label with less instruction overhead.

replacements.source: Nada sensível acontece sem você. Cada aprovação cobre uma ação exata.
replacements.before: Nothing sensitive happens without you. Each approval covers one exact action.
replacements.after: Review requests for sensitive actions. Each approval covers one specific action.
replacements.reason: Removes the unconditional claim that conflicts with always-allow rules.

replacements.source: Quando um agente quiser publicar, apagar ou enviar algo pra fora, o pedido aparece aqui e na conversa.
replacements.before: When an agent wants to publish, delete or send something out, the request shows up here and in the conversation.
replacements.after: Requests to publish, delete or send something appear here and in the conversation.
replacements.reason: Removes filler while preserving examples and locations.

replacements.source: O que espera por você: aprovações que você decide e perguntas dos agentes a você.
replacements.before: What waits on you: approvals you decide and the agents’ questions to you.
replacements.after: Approvals and questions from agents that need your response.
replacements.reason: Clarifies the inbox contents.

replacements.source: Quem está acima divide o trabalho com quem está abaixo e recebe a resposta de volta. O desenho organiza, mas não cerca: qualquer agente pode perguntar ou pedir uma parte pequena a qualquer outro.
replacements.before: Whoever is above splits the work with those below and gets the answer back. The chart organizes but doesn’t fence: any agent may ask any other a question or a small part.
replacements.after: Agents delegate to those below them and receive their answers. Any agent can still ask another a question or delegate a small task.
replacements.reason: Avoids introducing “Managers” as a new product role and retains cross-chart collaboration.

replacements.source: Modelo reserva
replacements.before: Reserve model
replacements.after: Fallback model
replacements.reason: Matches the existing fallback terminology.

replacements.source: Quando a assinatura do modelo principal chega no limite (o de 5 horas ou o semanal), a resposta segue no reserva, que pode estar em outro programa (Claude Code, Codex…) ou em outra conta. Na resposta seguinte, ${draft.name || 'o agente'} tenta o principal de novo.
replacements.before: When the main model’s subscription hits its limit (the 5-hour or the weekly one), the reply goes on with the reserve, which can be in another program (Claude Code, Codex…) or another account. On the next reply, ${draft.name || 'the agent'} tries the main one again.
replacements.after: At the main model’s 5-hour or weekly subscription limit, the reply continues with the fallback model, using another runtime or account if needed. On the next reply, ${draft.name || 'the agent'} tries the main model again.
replacements.reason: Removes unnecessary example runtimes while preserving both limits, continuation and next-reply reset.

replacements.source: Quando o principal chega no limite da assinatura.
replacements.before: When the main one hits its subscription limit.
replacements.after: Used when the main model reaches its subscription limit.
replacements.reason: Clarifies what is used and when.

replacements.source: Reserva
replacements.before: Reserve
replacements.after: Fallback
replacements.reason: Matches fallback model terminology.

replacements.source: Conta da reserva
replacements.before: Reserve account
replacements.after: Fallback account
replacements.reason: Matches fallback model terminology.

replacements.source: Essa conta ainda não entrou: a reserva só funciona depois que você entrar nela em Configurações › Modelos.
replacements.before: This account isn’t signed in yet: the reserve only works once you sign in under Settings › Models.
replacements.after: This account is not signed in. Sign in under Settings › Models to use it as a fallback.
replacements.reason: Uses consistent terminology and gives the recovery action.

replacements.source: Conta da reserva
replacements.before: Reserve account
replacements.after: Fallback account
replacements.reason: Matches fallback model terminology.

replacements.source: É o mesmo modelo, na mesma conta do principal: a reserva não vai ser usada.
replacements.before: It’s the same model, on the same account as the main one: the reserve won’t be used.
replacements.after: The fallback uses the same model and account as the main model, so it will not be used.
replacements.reason: Makes the condition explicit and matches fallback terminology.

replacements.source: É o mesmo programa, na mesma conta do principal: se o limite for da assinatura, ele também vai estar sem.
replacements.before: It’s the same program, on the same account as the main one: if the limit is the subscription’s, it’ll be out too.
replacements.after: The fallback uses the same runtime and account, so it also reaches the subscription limit.
replacements.reason: The surrounding main-model comparison supplies the reference; keeps the shared subscription consequence.

replacements.source: Escolha outra conta em “Conta da reserva”.
replacements.before: Pick another one under “Reserve account”.
replacements.after: Choose another account under “Fallback account”.
replacements.reason: Names the account rather than using an ambiguous “another”.

replacements.source: O time num arquivo .md (agentes, skills, canais e rotinas, sem credenciais nem conversas), pra guardar ou levar pra outro computador. Os agentes do OpenBot, do Grok Bot e do Hermes também entram, sem nenhum conector e com a busca na web desligada.
replacements.before: The team in a .md file (agents, skills, channels and routines, without credentials or conversations), to keep or take to another computer. Agents from OpenBot, Grok Bot and Hermes come in too, with no connector and web search off.
replacements.after: Export agents, skills, channels and routines as .md, without credentials or conversations. OpenBot, Grok Bot and Hermes imports have no connectors or web search.
replacements.reason: Removes redundant portability explanation while retaining all export contents, exclusions and import restrictions.

replacements.source: Trouxe o Tucano do seu computador? No app do computador, use Exportar tudo (Configurações › Geral) e envie o arquivo aqui: agentes, conversas, memórias, wiki e arquivos substituem os deste Tucano. Um backup diário (.db, da pasta de backups) também serve, só com o banco.
replacements.before: Bringing the Tucano from your computer? In the desktop app, use Export everything (Settings › General) and send the file here: agents, conversations, memories, wiki and files replace this Tucano's. A daily backup (.db, from the backups folder) works too, with the database only.
replacements.after: Use Export everything in the desktop app (Settings › General), then import the file here. It replaces this Tucano’s agents, conversations, memories, wiki and files. A daily .db backup from the backups folder restores only the database.
replacements.reason: Keeps replacement consequences, backup location and database-only scope.

replacements.source: Tudo deste Tucano num arquivo .zip: agentes, conversas, memórias, wiki e arquivos, pra levar pra um Tucano num servidor (como o Tucano Pro). As senhas dos conectores e os logins de IA não vão: eles ficam presos a este computador.
replacements.before: Everything of this Tucano in one .zip: agents, conversations, memories, wiki and files, to take to a Tucano on a server (such as Tucano Pro). Connector passwords and AI logins don't go: they're tied to this computer.
replacements.after: Export agents, conversations, memories, wiki and files to a .zip for a Tucano server, such as Tucano Pro. Connector passwords and AI logins stay on this computer.
replacements.reason: Shortens the credential exclusion while retaining its computer-specific scope.

replacements.source: Área de perigo
replacements.before: Danger area
replacements.after: Danger zone
replacements.reason: Uses the established name for destructive settings.

replacements.source: Área de perigo
replacements.before: Danger area
replacements.after: Danger zone
replacements.reason: Matches the section label.

replacements.after: Receive approval requests with buttons, agent questions and routine results in Telegram. Reply directly to question messages.

replacements.source: Só quem mandar este código fica com o bot. Esperando…

replacements.source: O texto fica no campo para você revisar antes de enviar.

replacements.before: The app’s language, and the one the agents reply in.

replacements.source: Entra em toda conversa de todo agente: quem você é, o que faz, o que importa agora e o que nunca fazer.

replacements.after: Included in every agent conversation: who you are, what you do, current priorities and what never to do.

replacements.before: How Tucano looks to you. It changes only for you.
replacements.after: Tucano’s appearance for you only.

replacements.source: Do sistema segue o claro e o escuro do computador ao longo do dia.
replacements.before: System follows the computer’s light and dark through the day.
replacements.after: System follows the computer’s light or dark theme.

replacements.source: O idioma do app pra você. Os agentes respondem no idioma do Tucano.
replacements.before: The app’s language for you. The agents reply in the Tucano’s language.
replacements.after: Your app language. Agents reply in the workspace language.

replacements.source: O toque quando um agente precisa de você e quando termina. Desligado, as notificações continuam aparecendo, em silêncio.
replacements.before: The chirp when an agent needs you and when it’s done. Off, notifications still show up, silently.
replacements.after: Plays a sound when an agent needs you or finishes. When off, notifications still appear silently.
replacements.reason: Retains explicit notification delivery when sounds are off.

replacements.source: Abre a lista do que o agente está fazendo embaixo da resposta. Desligado, fica só a linha com o que ele faz agora; um clique nela abre os passos. Muda só pra você.
replacements.before: Opens the list of what the agent is doing under its reply. Off, only the line with what it’s doing now stays; a click on it opens the steps. It changes only for you.
replacements.after: Shows steps under replies. When off, select the current step to see the list. This affects only you.
replacements.reason: The toggle label already supplies ongoing agent work; preserves collapsed interaction and personal scope.

replacements.source: De vez em quando, uma linha discreta no pé da barra com uma pergunta rápida. Pra isso o Tucano consulta tucano.sh algumas vezes por dia. Não manda nada seu.
replacements.before: Now and then, a quiet line at the foot of the sidebar with a quick question. For that, Tucano checks tucano.sh a few times a day. It sends nothing of yours.
replacements.after: Occasionally shows a sidebar survey. Tucano checks tucano.sh a few times a day and sends none of your data.
replacements.reason: Shortens the presentation description while preserving request frequency and data disclosure.

replacements.source: Um erro, uma ideia, qualquer coisa. Também em "Enviar feedback", no pé da barra.
replacements.before: A bug, an idea, anything. Also in "Send feedback", at the foot of the sidebar.
replacements.after: Send a bug report, idea or other feedback, also available at the foot of the sidebar.
replacements.reason: Keeps alternate location without a sentence fragment.

replacements.source: Pra todos os agentes: até onde eles vão sozinhos e o que pede sua aprovação antes, com um botão na conversa. Na página de cada agente dá pra mudar só pra ele. Ler e investigar nunca pede.
replacements.before: For every agent: how far they go on their own and what asks for your approval first, with a button in the conversation. On each agent’s page you can change it for that agent only. Reading and looking into things never asks.
replacements.after: Set default autonomy and approvals for all agents; override them on each agent’s page. Requests appear in the conversation. Reading and investigation never need approval.
replacements.reason: Retains global default, per-agent override, request location and read-only exemption.

replacements.source: Chegou nele, o agente pausa. Se estava avançando, segue sozinho (veja Continuar sozinho, abaixo); senão, você decide se continua. Num agente sem limite mensal, a conta é sobre 10 milhões de tokens.
replacements.before: When it hits it, the agent pauses. If it was getting somewhere it goes on by itself (see Keep going on its own, below); if not, you decide whether it continues. For an agent with no monthly limit, it is taken over 10 million tokens.
replacements.after: Pauses at the limit. With no monthly limit, the percentage uses 10 million tokens.
replacements.reason: The nearby Keep going on its own row explains continuation and its toggle. This hint keeps pause behavior and percentage basis within the measured narrow column.

replacements.source: Considerar travado após (min sem sinal)
replacements.before: Treat as stuck after (min with no sign)
replacements.after: Treat as stuck after (minutes inactive)
replacements.reason: The adjoining hint defines inactive as no text and no tool completion.

replacements.source: Sem texto nem ferramenta terminando. Trabalho longo que anda não é cortado.
replacements.before: No text and no tool finishing. Long work that’s moving isn’t cut off.
replacements.after: No text appears and no tool finishes. Work that is progressing is not interrupted.
replacements.reason: Defines inactivity in complete sentences without dropping the progressing-work exception.

replacements.source: Quando uma resposta chega no limite e estava avançando, o agente segue sozinho até ${AUTO_CONTINUES} vezes seguidas antes de esperar você. Uma resposta cortada porque o app fechou continua quando ele abre de novo. O limite do mês continua valendo.
replacements.before: When a reply reaches its limit while it was getting somewhere, the agent goes on by itself up to ${AUTO_CONTINUES} times in a row before waiting for you. A reply cut because the app closed goes on when it opens again. The monthly limit still holds.
replacements.after: At the reply limit, progress allows up to ${AUTO_CONTINUES} continuations before waiting for you. Replies resume after app restart. The monthly limit still applies.
replacements.reason: Preserves progress condition, consecutive continuation cap, wait, app-restart resume and monthly ceiling.

replacements.source: Assim nenhuma rotina depende de você lembrar de abrir o app.
replacements.before: So no routine depends on you remembering to open the app.
replacements.after: Starts Tucano so scheduled routines can run without opening it manually.
replacements.reason: Does not promise that routines always run, but explains startup’s purpose.

replacements.source: Rotinas e gatilhos esperam e rodam quando ele acaba (como atrasados). O que você mandar continua sendo respondido.
replacements.before: Routines and triggers wait and run when it ends (as late ones). What you send still gets answered.
replacements.after: Routines and triggers wait until quiet hours end, then run late. Your messages still receive replies.
replacements.reason: Removes awkward “as late” while preserving scheduling and message exception.

replacements.source: O que ele propõe entra assim que ele termina de responder, e o card ganha um Desfazer por ${UNDO_HOURS} horas. Acesso a conectores e o limite do mês continuam esperando você confirmar. Desligado, tudo espera você clicar em Aplicar.
replacements.before: What he proposes goes in as soon as he finishes replying, and the card gets an Undo for ${UNDO_HOURS} hours. Connector access and the monthly limit still wait for you to confirm. Off, everything waits for you to click Apply.
replacements.after: Tuca’s changes apply after his reply, with Undo on the card for ${UNDO_HOURS} hours. Connector access and monthly limits still need confirmation. When off, all changes wait for Apply.
replacements.reason: Preserves timing, undo window, sensitive exceptions and disabled behavior with less repetition.

replacements.source: Como o app acha o que o agente pede pra clicar (“o botão Buscar”). Pelo texto é de graça e resolve a maioria; quando não acha, o agente usa o número do elemento.
replacements.before: How the app finds what the agent asks to click (“the Search button”). By text it’s free and handles most cases; when it can’t find it, the agent uses the element’s number.
replacements.after: Finds the element an agent asks to click. Text matching is free; when it fails, the agent uses the element number.
replacements.reason: Preserves fallback behavior and cost without the optional success-rate claim.

replacements.source: Acha o elemento em menos de 1 segundo, até sem texto (pelo print da tela). Mas cada clique que o texto não resolve manda pra TypeSafe a lista de elementos da página e, às vezes, o print dela, inclusive em áreas logadas.
replacements.before: Finds the element in under 1 second, even without text (from the screenshot). But every click text can’t resolve sends TypeSafe the page’s element list and sometimes its screenshot, including signed-in areas.
replacements.after: Finds elements from screenshots in under 1 second, even without text. When text matching fails, TypeSafe receives the page’s element list and sometimes a screenshot, including signed-in areas.
replacements.reason: Retains performance claim and full privacy disclosure; necessary long warning exception.

replacements.source: Onde os agentes rodam: um endpoint seu, sem instalar nada, ou um programa como você configurou (no seu plano, no gateway da empresa ou nos seus provedores). Dos programas, o Tucano nunca vê nem guarda as credenciais; a chave de um endpoint fica guardada aqui, cifrada.
replacements.before: Where the agents run: an endpoint of yours, with nothing to install, or a program the way you set it up (on your plan, your company’s gateway or your providers). Tucano never sees or stores the programs’ credentials; an endpoint’s key is kept here, encrypted.
replacements.after: Use your endpoint without installing software, or a runtime on your plan, company gateway or provider. Tucano never sees or stores runtime credentials; endpoint keys stay encrypted here.
replacements.reason: Shortens runtime setup while retaining all account arrangements and credential boundaries.

replacements.source: Prefira um modelo rápido: ele roda antes de cada resposta num canal.
replacements.before: Go for a fast model: it runs before every reply in a channel.
replacements.after: Choose a fast model: it runs before every channel reply.
replacements.reason: Names the recommendation and reason directly.

replacements.source: Pra ser avisado, use o app do Tucano no computador (Configurações › Servidores), o app do iPhone ou o Telegram (Configurações › Celular).
replacements.before: To be told, use the Tucano app on your computer (Settings › Servers), the iPhone app or Telegram (Settings › Phone).
replacements.after: Or use the desktop app (Settings › Servers), iPhone app or Telegram (Settings › Phone).
replacements.reason: Shortens alternate notification routes shared by the blocked, unsupported and insecure states; all destinations remain.

replacements.source: O navegador bloqueou as notificações deste endereço. Libere nas permissões do site e recarregue a página.
replacements.before: The browser blocked notifications from this address. Allow them in the site’s permissions and reload the page.
replacements.after: Unblock site notifications, then reload.
replacements.reason: The blocked-state recovery is explicit in Unblock; preserves reload and the appended desktop/iPhone/Telegram routes.

replacements.source: Mandei uma. Se não apareceu, confira Ajustes do Sistema › Notificações › Tucano (permitir, e o estilo Faixas ou Alertas) e se um modo Foco está ligado.
replacements.before: Sent one. If it didn’t show, check System Settings › Notifications › Tucano (allowed, with Banners or Alerts) and whether a Focus is on.
replacements.after: Notification sent. If it did not appear, check System Settings › Notifications › Tucano (allow notifications with Banners or Alerts) and Focus.
replacements.reason: Clarifies the test result and troubleshooting steps.

replacements.source: Mandei uma. Se não apareceu, confira as notificações do sistema e do navegador para o Tucano, e o modo Não perturbe.
replacements.before: Sent one. If it didn’t show, check the system’s and the browser’s notification settings for Tucano, and Do Not Disturb.
replacements.after: Notification sent. If it did not appear, check the system and browser notification settings for Tucano and Do Not Disturb.

replacements.source: Manda uma notificação agora, pra ver se chega.
replacements.before: Sends a notification now, to see that it comes.

replacements.source: Os agentes de lá passam a usar o terminal, as pastas que você emprestar, o navegador e os apps deste computador, só quando trabalham pra você, com as aprovações configuradas lá. Funciona enquanto este app estiver aberto. Desligue aqui a qualquer hora.
replacements.before: Its agents get to use this computer’s terminal, the folders you lend, its browser and apps, only when they work for you, under the approvals set there. It works while this app is open. Turn it off here any time.
replacements.after: Its agents can use this computer’s terminal, shared folders, browser and apps only when working for you, under the server’s approvals. Access lasts while this app is open. Turn it off here at any time.
replacements.reason: Preserve resources, requester scope, approval authority, open-app dependency and revocation in a shorter disclosure.

replacements.source: Quem empresta é o workspace principal: as pastas e os apps estão nas Configurações dele.
replacements.before: The main workspace lends it: the folders and apps are in its Settings.
replacements.after: The main workspace shares this computer. Its folders and apps are in Settings.
replacements.reason: Replace the ambiguous lending metaphor while retaining the settings location.

replacements.source: Escolha, no servidor, os agentes que usam este computador.
replacements.before: Pick, on the server, the agents that use this computer.
replacements.after: On the server, choose the agents that can use this computer.
replacements.reason: State where the choice is made and what it controls.

replacements.source: Pra ${lent.map((s) => s.name).join(', ')}: o terminal, o navegador e os conectores deste computador vão junto; as pastas e os apps, só os de baixo. Tudo segue as aprovações configuradas no servidor.
replacements.before: To ${lent.map((s) => s.name).join(', ')}: this computer’s terminal, browser and connectors come along; folders and apps, only the ones below. Everything follows the approvals set on the server.
replacements.after: Shared with ${lent.map((s) => s.name).join(', ')}: this computer’s terminal, browser and connectors, plus only the folders and apps listed below. All access follows the approvals set on the server.
replacements.reason: Clarify the shared resources and preserve the server approval condition; measure the rendered warning.

replacements.source: As ferramentas de arquivo do servidor só alcançam estas pastas. O terminal alcança o que você alcança, com as mesmas aprovações de um agente neste computador.
replacements.before: The server's file tools only reach these folders. The terminal reaches what you reach, under the same approvals as an agent on this computer.
replacements.after: The server’s file tools can access only these folders. The terminal can access what you can, under the same approvals as an agent on this computer.
replacements.reason: Retain the distinction between file-tool restrictions and terminal access using shorter wording.

replacements.source: Nenhuma pasta ainda: as ferramentas de arquivo do servidor não leem nem gravam nada aqui. Empreste as pastas dos seus projetos. O terminal alcança o que você alcança, com as mesmas aprovações de um agente neste computador.
replacements.before: No folders yet: the server's file tools don't read or write anything here. Lend your projects' folders. The terminal reaches what you reach, under the same approvals as an agent on this computer.
replacements.after: No folders shared. The server’s file tools cannot read or write files here until you share folders. The terminal can access what you can, under the same approvals as an agent on this computer.
replacements.reason: Keep the empty state and explicit terminal exception without unnecessary wording.

replacements.source: Nada com “${query.trim()}”. Tente outra palavra, como “limite”, “modelo” ou “som”.
replacements.before: Nothing for “${query.trim()}”. Try another word, like “limit”, “model” or “sound”.
replacements.after: No results for “${query.trim()}”. Try “limit”, “model” or “sound”.
replacements.reason: Keeps concrete recovery examples while removing redundant search instruction.

replacements.source: Você tinha tirado da barra. Some de novo quando nada esperar por você.
replacements.before: You took it out of the sidebar. It goes again once nothing waits on you.
replacements.after: You removed this from the sidebar. It hides again when nothing needs your attention.
replacements.reason: Preserves hidden-item restoration and attention condition.

replacements.source: Isso dá acesso ou mexe no gasto: só vale quando você confirmar.
replacements.before: This grants access or changes spending: it only counts once you confirm it.
replacements.after: This grants access or changes spending. It takes effect only after you confirm it.
replacements.reason: Names the consequence and confirmation requirement directly.

replacements.source: Sem internet pra procurar uma versão nova. O Tucano tenta de novo sozinho mais tarde.
replacements.before: No internet to check for updates. Tucano tries again on its own later.
replacements.after: No internet connection. Tucano will try checking for updates again later.
replacements.reason: Names the failed check and automatic retry.

replacements.source: Os agentes deixam de poder usar essa chave, e o valor sai do chaveiro do sistema. Um conector que aponta pra ela para de conectar. Não dá pra desfazer.
replacements.before: The agents can no longer use this key, and its value leaves the system keychain. A connector pointing to it stops connecting. This can’t be undone.
replacements.after: Agents can no longer use this key, and its value is removed from the system keychain. A connector using it will stop connecting. This cannot be undone.
replacements.reason: Clarify the deletion consequences and irreversibility.

replacements.source: Os agentes deixam de entrar sozinhos nesse site, e a senha sai do chaveiro do sistema. O que já está logado no navegador deles continua até sair.
replacements.before: The agents stop signing in to that site on their own, and the password leaves the system keychain. What’s already signed in in their browsers stays until they sign out.
replacements.after: Agents will no longer sign in to this site automatically, and the password is removed from the system keychain. Existing browser sessions remain signed in until signed out.
replacements.reason: Clarify that deleting the login does not sign out existing browser sessions.

replacements.source: Nenhum login seu.
replacements.before: No logins of yours.
replacements.after: You have no logins yet.
replacements.reason: Use natural empty-state wording.

replacements.source: Novo login meu…
replacements.before: New login of mine…
replacements.after: New personal login…
replacements.reason: Name the action and ownership directly.

replacements.source: Nenhuma chave sua.
replacements.before: No keys of yours.
replacements.after: You have no keys yet.
replacements.reason: Use natural empty-state wording.

replacements.source: Nova chave minha…
replacements.before: New key of mine…
replacements.after: New personal key…
replacements.reason: Name the action and ownership directly.

replacements.source: Use o endereço do site, com https: conta.exemplo.com.br.
replacements.before: Use the site’s address, with https: account.example.com.
replacements.after: Enter the site address with HTTPS, for example https://account.example.com.
replacements.reason: Correct the incomplete HTTPS example in the validation error.

replacements.source: Novo login seu
replacements.before: New login of yours
replacements.after: New personal login
replacements.reason: Name the ownership directly.

replacements.source: Fica cifrada no chaveiro do sistema. Um op://Cofre/Item/senha vem do 1Password na hora.
replacements.before: It stays encrypted in the system keychain. An op://Vault/Item/password comes from 1Password at the moment.
replacements.after: The password stays encrypted in the system keychain. An op://Vault/Item/password reference is read from 1Password when used.
replacements.reason: Retain storage and just-in-time resolution with less technical phrasing.

replacements.source: Cada agente tem um login por site: liberar este tira o outro.
replacements.before: Each agent has one login per site: giving this one takes the other away.
replacements.after: Each agent can have one login per site. Assigning this login replaces its existing login for that site.
replacements.reason: Make the replacement consequence explicit.

replacements.source: Nova chave sua
replacements.before: New key of yours
replacements.after: New personal key
replacements.reason: Name the ownership directly.

replacements.source: Nenhum ainda: a chave fica guardada até você liberar.
replacements.before: None yet: the key stays put until you give it out.
replacements.after: No agents selected. The key remains unassigned until you choose an agent.
replacements.reason: Replace vague phrasing with the assignment state.

replacements.source: O comando espera alguém aprovar, com o comando inteiro à vista. Pra chaves que mexem em dinheiro ou em produção.
replacements.before: The command waits for someone to approve, with the whole command in view. For keys that touch money or production.
replacements.after: The command waits for approval, and the full command is shown to the approver. Use this for keys that affect money or production.
replacements.reason: Clarify the approval behavior and preserve the recommendation; measure the rendered hint.

replacements.source: Cole o conteúdo do arquivo. Cada NOME=valor vira uma chave, sem nenhum agente liberado: você escolhe depois.
replacements.before: Paste the file’s content. Each NAME=value becomes a key, given to no agent: you choose afterwards.
replacements.after: Paste the file contents. Each NAME=value becomes a key without an assigned agent; you choose agents afterwards.
replacements.reason: Clarify the import and default assignment while retaining the literal syntax.

replacements.source: Nada do Cofre foi usado ainda. Cada uso aparece aqui: qual chave ou login, qual agente, pra quem e onde.
replacements.before: Nothing in the Vault was used yet. Each use shows here: which key or login, which agent, for whom and where.
replacements.after: No Vault items have been used yet. Each use shows the key or login, agent, who it was used for and where.
replacements.reason: Keep requester attribution distinct from a generic person; the log links to the conversation rather than showing a physical location.

replacements.source: Fica entre as do time.
replacements.before: It goes among the team’s.
replacements.after: Saved with the team’s items.
replacements.reason: Shorten the ownership hint without losing its destination.

replacements.source: Fica entre as suas: ${who} só usa no que você pedir, e este pedido é de ${requester}.
replacements.before: It goes among yours: ${who} only uses it in what you ask for, and this request is ${requester}’s.
replacements.after: Saved with your items. ${who} can use it only for work you request. This request is from ${requester}.
replacements.reason: Retain the ownership/use restriction and requester attribution in shorter sentences.

replacements.source: Fica entre as suas: ${who} usa no que você pedir.
replacements.before: It goes among yours: ${who} uses it in what you ask for.
replacements.after: Saved with your items. ${who} can use it for work you request.
replacements.reason: Shorten the ownership disclosure while preserving its use condition.

replacements.source: Já tem uma do time no Cofre
replacements.before: There’s a team one in the Vault
replacements.after: A team item is already in the Vault
replacements.reason: Replace an incomplete noun phrase with a clear status.

replacements.source: Já tem uma do time no Cofre: só um admin libera.
replacements.before: There’s a team one in the Vault: only an admin gives it out.
replacements.after: A team item is already in the Vault. Only an admin can assign it.
replacements.reason: Clarify the item and admin-only assignment restriction.

replacements.source: Guardar no Cofre e liberar
replacements.before: Keep in the Vault and give
replacements.after: Save in the Vault and assign
replacements.reason: Name the two actions directly.

replacements.source: Vai direto pro Cofre, cifrado: não aparece na conversa, e ${who} nunca vê.
replacements.before: It goes straight into the Vault, encrypted: it doesn’t show in the conversation, and ${who} never sees it.
replacements.after: Saved directly in the Vault, encrypted. It does not appear in the conversation, and ${who} never sees it.
replacements.reason: Shorten while retaining encryption and both visibility restrictions.

replacements.source: Num servidor, transcreve umas 5 vezes mais rápido e erra um pouco mais.
replacements.before: On a server, it transcribes about 5 times faster, and gets a bit more wrong.
replacements.after: On a server, transcription is about 5 times faster but slightly less accurate.
replacements.reason: Makes the speed and accuracy tradeoff explicit.

replacements.source: O áudio vira texto no servidor deste Tucano, sem passar por nenhum outro serviço. Num servidor, o modelo Leve é bem mais rápido.
replacements.before: The audio becomes text on this Tucano's server, through no other service. On a server, the Light model is much faster.
replacements.after: Audio is transcribed only on this server.
replacements.reason: Keeps the server-only transcription disclosure. Light speed guidance remains in the immediately adjacent Light model option, so the lead need not repeat it.

replacements.source: Clique no microfone, ou ${key('Espaço')}, e fale. Clique de novo para terminar: o texto aparece aqui para você revisar. Na primeira vez, o sistema pede para liberar o microfone.
replacements.before: Click the microphone, or ${key('Space')}, and speak. Click again to finish: the text shows up here to review. The first time, the system asks to allow the microphone.
replacements.after: Use the microphone or ${key('Space')} to dictate. Select the microphone again to finish and review the text here. Allow microphone access when first asked.
replacements.reason: Preserves shortcut, microphone finish action, review location and first-use permission. Full multi-step instruction requires rendered measurement.

replacements.source: Nada no lugar: o trecho só sai da página.
replacements.before: This passage leaves the page, with nothing in its place.
replacements.after: This passage will be removed from the page without a replacement.
replacements.reason: States the removal and absence of replacement directly.

replacements.source: Tudo em ordem. Nada pra cuidar agora.
replacements.before: All in order. Nothing to look after now.
replacements.after: Nothing needs attention.
replacements.reason: Replaces an indirect empty-state message with the current state.

replacements.source: Nunca vêm: mensagens, memórias, resumos, aprovações, histórico de uso, arquivos dos computadores, sessões do navegador e as contas extras do Claude Code e do Codex (na cópia, os agentes usam o login padrão). O Telegram fica no workspace padrão. Mudanças aqui não alteram o original; pastas emprestadas continuam sendo as mesmas.
replacements.before: Never coming: messages, memories, summaries, approvals, usage history, computers’ files, browser sessions and the extra Claude Code and Codex accounts (in the copy, agents use the usual sign-in). Telegram stays in the default workspace. Changes here don’t change the original; lent folders are still the same ones.
replacements.after: The copy excludes messages, memories, summaries, approvals, usage history, computer files, browser sessions and extra Claude Code and Codex accounts. Agents use the default sign-in. Telegram stays in the default workspace. Settings are independent; lent folders remain shared.
replacements.reason: Preserves every exclusion, default account behavior, Telegram scope and shared-folder consequence. Privacy/data-warning line exception: all excluded data and shared-folder disclosure must remain visible.

replacements.source: Trocar o modelo de vários agentes
replacements.before: Change several agents’ model
replacements.after: Change models for several agents
replacements.reason: Fixes awkward possessive grammar in the search vocabulary; no behavior change.

replacements.source: O endpoint recusou a chave. Confira a chave dele em Configurações › Modelos.
replacements.before: The endpoint refused the key. Check its key in Settings › Models.
replacements.after: The endpoint rejected the key. Check the key in Settings › Models.
replacements.reason: Removes the ambiguous repeated possessive while preserving the recovery path.

replacements.source: A resposta terminou antes de ler isto
replacements.before: The reply ended before reading this instruction.
replacements.after: The reply ended before the agent read this instruction.
replacements.reason: Name the agent as the actor reading instructions.

replacements.source: Desligado: o app do Tucano está fechado lá. Ao abrir, volta sozinho.
replacements.before: Off: the Tucano app is closed there. Opening it brings it back.
replacements.after: Tucano is closed on this computer. Open it to reconnect.
replacements.reason: Distinguish the closed app from computer power and name recovery.

replacements.source: Chega quando a resposta acima terminar
replacements.before: Goes when the reply above ends
replacements.after: Runs after the reply above finishes
replacements.reason: Name the queued action.

replacements.source: Orientação para a resposta em curso
replacements.before: A steer for the reply running now
replacements.after: Instructions for the current reply
replacements.reason: Use a natural accessible field name.

replacements.source: Recolher o que ele pensou
replacements.before: Fold what it thought
replacements.after: Collapse reasoning
replacements.reason: Name the disclosure action using the established term.

replacements.source: Ler o que ele pensou
replacements.before: Read what it thought
replacements.after: Show reasoning
replacements.reason: Name the disclosure action using the established term.

replacements.source: Enquanto uma resposta corre aqui, o Enter manda assim. Clique para voltar ao normal; os atalhos continuam valendo uma vez cada (Ctrl+Enter põe na fila, Alt+Enter entrega, Shift+Alt+Enter interrompe, Shift+Enter quebra a linha).
replacements.before: While a reply runs here, Enter sends like this. Click to go back to the plain one; the keys still work once each (Ctrl+Enter queues, Alt+Enter hands it over, Shift+Alt+Enter interrupts, Shift+Enter breaks the line).
replacements.after: Enter uses this mode during a reply. Select to restore parallel replies. Shortcuts apply to one send: Ctrl+Enter queues; Alt+Enter steers; Shift+Alt+Enter interrupts. Shift+Enter adds a line.
replacements.reason: Identify the restored mode and preserve all shortcuts and their per-send scope.

replacements.source: Enter: entregue à resposta
replacements.before: Enter: into the reply
replacements.after: Enter: steer
replacements.reason: Name the action consistently with the mode.

replacements.source: O que o modelo pensa
replacements.before: What the model is thinking
replacements.after: Show reasoning
replacements.reason: Describe the enabled behavior and synchronize its search label.

replacements.source: Enquanto um agente responde, o raciocínio dele aparece em letra pequena e apagada, embaixo dos passos, e fica ali depois que a resposta acaba. Desligado, você vê só os passos e a resposta. Por enquanto, só os agentes que rodam no Pi mandam o raciocínio.
replacements.before: While an agent replies, its reasoning shows in small, dim text under the steps, and it stays there once the reply ends. Off, you see only the steps and the answer. For now only agents running on Pi send their reasoning.
replacements.after: Shows reasoning below the steps, during and after replies. When off, only steps and answers appear. Currently available only with Pi.
replacements.reason: Preserve timing, off state and Pi availability while removing visual narration.

replacements.source: Um novo prompt com uma resposta em curso
replacements.before: While a reply is running
replacements.after: New prompts during a reply
replacements.reason: Name what the choice controls and synchronize its search label.

replacements.source: O que o modelo pensa
replacements.before: What the model is thinking
replacements.after: Show reasoning
replacements.reason: Describe the enabled behavior and synchronize its search label.

replacements.source: Um novo prompt com uma resposta em curso
replacements.before: While a reply is running
replacements.after: New prompts during a reply
replacements.reason: Name what the choice controls and synchronize its search label.
